description: This file implements a UWP API wrapper for Windows 10 shell commands, including functions for managing UWP packages and processes, and provides an interactive command line interface for package and process management.

classes.name: UwpApi
classes.description: A class that wraps Windows 10 UWP shell commands for package and process management, providing methods to list, install, remove, and interact with UWP packages and processes.

methods.name: ExecutePowershellScript
methods.description: Executes a PowerShell script with optional arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: GetPackageDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for a given UWP package name.

methods.name: GetPackageAppMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of package names to their applications, filtered by package or app name.

methods.name: GetRunningProcessMap
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of process IDs to process names, filtered by executable name.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from a string if present.
